title: (No AI) Of course the ChatGPT dog cancer vaccine spawned a startup
author: Robert Hart
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/acastro_201217_1777_vaccine_0001.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Remember that much-hyped story about an Australian tech entrepreneur using ChatGPT, Grok, and other AI tools to [craft a personalized cancer vaccine for his dog](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/896878/ai-did-not-cure-this-dogs-cancer)? Well, surprise: he's launched a startup.

That entrepreneur is Paul Conyngham, who says he is launching Gamgee to offer "personalised mRNA cancer vaccines for dogs." But his ambitions go well beyond dogs - and pets - with Gamgee's website promising the company will harness AI and genetics to develop personalized treatments for a range of diseases and species, including humans.

title: (No AI) Grok is now an AI ‘teammate’ you can assign work
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![Screenshots showing Grok Bot running on desktop and iOS.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/Grok-Bot-desktop-and-iOS.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

You’ll have to be fine with letting Grok sign into your online accounts, however. | Image: SpaceXAI

SpaceXAI has introduced [Grok Bot](https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot), an always-on AI agent service designed to behave like independent "AI teammates" that can do your work for you. The bots share their own cloud-based computer environment, and can sign into apps, tools, and websites you already use to complete multi-step workplace tasks, only coming back when their assigned work is completed or if something requires approval.

Grok Bot (or Bots, as SpaceXAI inconsistently pluralizes it) is the latest push from Elon Musk's AI company to keep up with business services launched by rival AI providers, including OpenAI's [ChatGPT Work](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/963464/openai-gpt-5-6-codex-chatgpt-work), Anthropic's [Claude Cowork](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/961978/anthropic-claude-cowork-mobile-web), and Microsoft's [Cop …](https://www.theverge.com/tech/885741/microsoft-copilot-tasks-ai)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/978666/spacexai-grok-bot-ai-agent-beta-launch)
